newsitem.title: INDIA: India castor prices up sharply on export deal news.
newsitem.headline: India castor prices up sharply on export deal news.

text.p: Indian castorseed March delivery prices rose sharply on Monday to 1,140/1,141 rupees from 1,132/1,133 rupees on reports of export deals and short-covering, dealers said.

"Indian exporters have finalised deals to export about 4-5,000 tonnes of castoroil at the rate of 660 rupees per tonne," one broker said. Castorseed prices from south India remained high on limited supply with buyers from there entering the Gujarat market, lifting prices there too.
Groundnut oil fell 344/345 to 341/342 rupees on high supply. About 2,000/2,500 tonnes of imported palm oil arrived in Bombay.
